findings.summary: Real HTTP INVALID_CURSOR errors no longer reach the gateway cursor-reset branch.
findings.evidence: Fresh Probe G: exit 0 reproducer; loopback laptop HTTP 400 {code:INVALID_CURSOR} leaves runtime.event_cursor='stale-cursor'. upstream.LaptopClient.get_json flattens HTTPError into UpstreamError, so app.py/_poll_events and StreamHub's UpstreamResponseError branch are unreachable for actual HTTP. Current tests inject the exception directly. Preserve structured HTTP errors and test with real client/HTTP.

findings.summary: Gateway HTTP 200 for failed effects makes the phone clear forms and treat failed reopen as successful.

Map failure codes and validate semantic outcome before success UI. Anthropic finding 4 confirms.

findings.summary: Upstream command errors misclassify known connection failure and an uncertain malformed successful response.
findings.evidence: Fresh Probe I: exit 0 reproducer; real HTTP 200 with invalid JSON after POST is reported FAILED/LAPTOP_UNAVAILABLE, while mocked URLError(ConnectionRefusedError) becomes UNKNOWN_OUTCOME. upstream.py catches URLError in its earlier OSError branch; malformed post-success JSON goes to plain UpstreamError even though effects may have run. Preserve UNKNOWN_OUTCOME and exact key when execution is uncertain. Anthropic finding 6 confirms; IncompleteRead was not dynamically tested.
